## Re-review verdict: APPROVE

**Prior finding RESOLVED.** Iteration-1's Important (silent-failure-hunter): `$failed_direct_present` keyed on array container type alone, letting a malformed-element `phase3_failed_agents` array re-collapse an uncovered silent agent onto `silent`. Commit 3dfe163be replaces the container-type check with element-aware establishment — `(if $failed_is_array then ($failed_raw | map(type == "string") | all) else false end)` — so any array containing a non-string element establishes nothing and the uncovered silent agent falls to `unestablished` (fail closed), while `[]` stays a valid none-failed establishment (`all` over empty = true).

**Verification performed:**
- Read the jq producer delta and traced every operand: `$failed_direct` derives only when `$failed_direct_present`; the per-agent `$failed_established` argument (`$failed_direct_present or assessment-covered`) and `$is_failed` (`$failed_agents index`) remain correct under the narrowed establishment. Fail-closed on every malformed shape confirmed by inspection.
- Two new adversarial fixtures added (all-object array; mixed string+number) each assert both `disposition == unestablished` and `phase3_failed_agents_present == false` — closing the exact gap the iteration-1 REJECT named, including the mixed case where a *real* agent name is present beside junk.
- Ran covering module `efficiency-trace-telemetry`: **987 passed, 0 failed** (floor raised to 983); all 36 `#1849` assertions pass, including the shadow `returned:true`→`silent` channel, the `not_verified` coverage gate, and object/scalar/malformed-entry shadow arms.

No new Critical/Important findings. The additive `disposition`/`fix_decisions` fields introduce no new verdict and perturb no existing derivation. Iteration-1 Suggestions (untested returned-wins precedence, fix_decisions dedup, partial-shadow matrix, comment nits) remain advisory and below threshold — not blocking.

**Verdict: APPROVE.**
